notes.title: The Bouncy Pounce Charm
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Progress on Tailless Frank is going strong. The mechanic I want to share with you today is Special Items.
Special Items can be found on rewards after defeating all the enemies in a room and they can enhance several aspects of the gameplay.

One such item is the [b]Bouncy Pounce Charm[/b]. This will make the projectiles bounce a few times before expiring with each bounce being able to deal damage to your opponents.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465766/2ba0ff7686529afeff2e350a6d949f7b521c8433.png[/img]

In other updates: the beta will be available in a few weeks. Join our mailing list if you want to save a spot and be among the first to play the game 👉 [url=https://danviegames.com/]danviegames.com/[/url]
